description: This file contains low-level implementations of big number arithmetic functions for cryptographic operations, including multiplication, squaring, addition, and subtraction of large integers, with architecture-specific optimizations.

methods.name: bn_mul_add_words
methods.description: Multiplies an array of words by a single word and adds the result to another array, returning the carry.

methods.name: bn_mul_words
methods.description: Multiplies an array of words by a single word.

methods.name: bn_mul_comba8
methods.description: Performs multiplication of two 8-word big numbers using Comba method.

methods.name: bn_mul_comba4
methods.description: Performs multiplication of two 4-word big numbers using Comba method.

methods.name: bn_sqr_comba8
methods.description: Squares an 8-word big number using Comba method.

methods.name: bn_sqr_comba4
methods.description: Squares a 4-word big number using Comba method.

methods.name: bn_add_words
methods.description: Adds two arrays of words representing big numbers.

methods.name: bn_sub_words
methods.description: Subtracts one array of words from another representing big numbers.
